Fact-check one claim from a short video using ONLY the numbered evidence below.

VIDEO DATE: 2019-01-29
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: The problem with wind is, in the United States, we’re subsidizing these wind towers all over the place because wind doesn’t work — for the most part, doesn’t work without subsidy
CLAIM: The problem with wind is, in the United States, we’re subsidizing these wind towers all over the place because wind doesn’t work — for the most part, doesn’t work without subsidy
QUESTIONS TO ANSWER FIRST:
- Does USA have wind turbines?
- Does USA have a subsidy system for wind turbines?
- What do America's Wind Turbines cost to product a Megawatt of electricity?
- Would America's Wind Turbines be profitable if they were not subsidised?

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://www.sanders.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/options-to-finance-medicare-for-all.pdf Bernie Sanders' document presented a number of options to begin a discussion about the best way of financing Medicare-for-all.
[2] https://www.lazard.com/media/450784/lazards-levelized-cost-of-energy-version-120-vfinal.pdf The EIA, estimated the average cost without subsidies would be $48.80/MWh for wind turbines.
[3] https://www.whio.com/news/local/what-are-pepper-balls-used-police-disperse-students/2uiSBgUySxwuXgOJ5VjkOJ/ A pepper ball is typically a projectile filled with pepper spray, usually launched from a device similar to a pistol. Police often carry them on their utility belts. According to a company that manufactures pepper balls, they are designed to create a 12-foot cloud with an irritant designed to affect the eyes, nose and throat of the people who are hit by the cloud.
[4] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Energy_subsidies_in_the_United_States A 2017 report by Management Information Services Inc found that non-hydro renewable energy (primarily wind and solar) benefited from $158 billion in federal subsidies, or 16% of the total energy subsidies, largely in the form of tax policy and direct federal expenditures on research and development (R&D).
[5] https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/nova/article/can-wind-turbines-make-you-sick/ Yes. The United States ranks first in the world for electricity generated from wind, according to the Department of Energy.
[6] https://www.lazard.com/media/450784/lazards-levelized-cost-of-energy-version-120-vfinal.pdf Lazard, an investment bank, estimated in November 2018 that unsubsidized wind costs between $29-$56 per MWh and with subsidies, wind costs between $14-$47 per MWh.

- contradicted: reliable evidence shows the claim is false or misleading
- unverified: the evidence does not settle it either way

For supported or contradicted, cite the evidence numbers and copy the exact sentence from each that backs your label. If the evidence doesn't settle it, answer unverified with no citations.

{"label": "unverified", "rationale": "Evidence is not clear on whether subsidizing is a bad thing and whether it would be profitable if wind turbines were not subsided. Also, the U.S. also ranks first in the world for electricity generated from wind - meaning the U.S. depends heavily on wind power.", "citations": []}

Fact-check one claim from a short video using ONLY the numbered evidence below.

VIDEO DATE: 2020-09-06
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: 53 Johannes Ramokhoase street Pretoria is a human trafficking hotspot.
CLAIM: 53 Johannes Ramokhoase street Pretoria is a human trafficking hotspot.
QUESTIONS TO ANSWER FIRST:
- What do the police say about the building in question?

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://web.archive.org/web/20210418075221/https://africacheck.org/sites/default/files/Housing-delivery-1994-to-2018.pdf Looking within 1994/95 to 1998/99, 1999/2000 to 2003/04, 2004/05 to 2008/09, 2009/10 to 2013/14 and 2014/15 to 2018/19*. None of the five consecutive years have seen the construction of one million housing units. The highest 5-year period to see the most housing units built was in the years 1999/2000 to 2003/2004, which saw 758,342 houses built.
[2] Metadata 787 schools have been completed.
[3] https://www.saps.gov.za/newsroom/msspeechdetail.php?nid=28140 “A series of social media posts depicting a building in Pretoria being used as a centre for human trafficking is fake news,” the police said in a statement.

“The building, which is on Johannes Ramokhoase Street, Pretoria CBD is in fact a residential building accommodating policemen and women. Therefore, the posts suggesting that this building is being used for criminal activities is misleading and untrue.”

Fact-check one claim from a short video using ONLY the numbered evidence below.

VIDEO DATE: 2020-01-30
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: President Donald Trump claimed that the new trade agreement with China “will boost American agriculture by $50 billion every year.”
CLAIM: President Donald Trump claimed that the new trade agreement with China “will boost American agriculture by $50 billion every year.”
QUESTIONS TO ANSWER FIRST:
- Would the new Trump-trade agreement between US and  China boost American agriculture by $50 billion every year?
- What does the China-US trade deal mean for US agriculture?

EVIDENCE:
[1] Metadata If U.S. ag exports to China do reach $40 billion in the future, that would be a 54% increase, and $50 billion would be 93% — not “two and a half, three times what China had purchased at its highest point.”

That is still a substantial increase, but not nearly as high as Trump said, and we don’t know if U.S. agricultural exports to China will ever get that high.
[2] https://sd11.senate.ca.gov/news/20190122-senator-wiener-introduces-legislation-end-discrimination-against-lgbt-people-regarding for consensual yet illegal sexual relations between a teenager age 15 and over and a partner within 10 years of age, “sexual intercourse” (i.e., vaginal intercourse) does not require the offender to go onto the sex offender registry; rather, the judge decides based on the facts of the case whether sex offender registration is warranted or unwarranted. By contrast, for other forms of intercourse — specifically, oral and anal intercourse — sex offender registration is mandated under all situations, with no judicial discretion.
[3] https://uk-air.defra.gov.uk/research/ozone-uv/moreinfo?view=deleption-climate-change#:~:text=Ozone%20depletion%20and%20climate%20change%20are%20linked%20in%20a%20number,radiation%2C%20which%20heats%20the%20stratosphere. Atmospheric ozone has two effects on the temperature balance of the Earth. It absorbs solar ultraviolet radiation, which heats the stratosphere. It also absorbs infrared radiation emitted by the Earth's surface, effectively trapping heat in the troposphere. Therefore, the climate impact of changes in ozone concentrations varies with the altitude at which these ozone changes occur. The major ozone losses that have been observed in the lower stratosphere due to the human-produced chlorine- and bromine-containing gases have a cooling effect on the Earth's surface. On the other hand, the ozone increases that are estimated to have occurred in the troposphere because of surface-pollution gases have a warming effect on the Earth's surface, thereby contributing to the "greenhouse" effect.
[4] https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-idCAKBN1ZB0LU Mnuchin told Fox News Channel that the deal reached on Dec. 13 still calls for China to buy $40 billion to $50 billion worth of U.S. agricultural products annually and a total of $200 billion of U.S. goods over two years.

“It wasn’t changed in translation. I don’t know where that rumor started,” Mnuchin said on the “Sunday Morning Futures with Maria Bartiromo” show.

“We have been going through a translation process that I think we said was really a technical issue,” Mnuchin said. “And the language will be released this week. So I think it is -- the day of the signing, we will be releasing the English version.”

VIDEO DATE: 2020-01-01
TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT: Hot temperatures in a car can cause hand sanitiser to catch fire without a spark.
CLAIM: Hot temperatures in a car can cause hand sanitiser to catch fire without a spark.
QUESTIONS TO ANSWER FIRST:
- Can hand sanitiser catch fire?
- Can alcohol based hand sanitiser ignite without being near a flame or spark?
- Is a hot car hot enough to ignite an alcohol based substance?
- Have there been any reported incidents of alcohol based hand sanitiser catching fire in a hot vehicle?

EVIDENCE:
[1] https://legalresearch.blogs.bris.ac.uk/tag/devyani-prabhat/ RICHARD Madeley got into a heated clash with the lawyer representing Shamima Begum’s family, Tasnime Akunjee...

[2] https://news.asu.edu/20180516-discoveries-asu-study-hot-cars-can-hit-deadly-temperatures-within-one-hour No
[3] https://www.acs.org/content/acs/en/education/resources/highschool/chemmatters/past-issues/2015-2016/december-2015/safety-data-sheets.html The autoignition temperature is the temperature at which a substance will burst into flames without an outside ignition source, such as a spark or a flame. At the auto-ignition temperature, spontaneous combustion occurs. According to the SDS for methanol, the auto ignition temperature is 464 °C.

The History of Pandemics

Pan·dem·ic /panˈdemik/ (of a disease) prevalent over a whole country or the world.

As humans have spread across the world, so have infectious diseases. Even in this modern era, outbreaks are nearly constant, though not every outbreak reaches pandemic level as COVID-19 has.

Today’s visualization outlines some of history’s most deadly pandemics, from the Antonine Plague to the current COVID-19 event.
A Timeline of Historical Pandemics

Disease and illnesses have plagued humanity since the earliest days, our mortal flaw. However, it was not until the marked shift to agrarian communities that the scale and spread of these diseases increased dramatically.
